text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty -> ALERT fired: service=runtime-proxy-eu route=/v1/generate metric=p99_latency value=1.82s threshold=1.2s (SLO burn 16%) pd-id=pd-889302

sophia: saw the PD alert, joining

deploy-bot: rollout finished ~6m ago: model-a v1.4.3 -> canary (100% traffic) (deploy-id=dl-20260317-0812)

mateo: thanks. I'm checking recent deploy + autoscaler. any quick hits?

ana: (typo) ana: checking metrics now — p95 up to 420ms, p99 1.8s, queue depth on proxy pods spiking, KV cache evictions high :chart_with_upwards_trend:

zack: looking at sidecar logs, seeing repeated `kvcache: miss` followed by `fetch backend` + some 500s from a single host ip-10-2-7-54

sophia: can we confirm any regional preemptions or node restarts?

mateo: no preemptions on hosts, GPU mem steady. autoscaler isn't adding replicas — scale-up requests queued. suspect warmup/backpressure from recent model change.

zack: opening quick grep of recent errors:
```
kubectl -n prod logs proxy-xyz --since=5m | grep -E "kvcache|timeout|evict|504"
# shows 30+ kvcache eviction entries and intermittent downstream 504s
```

ana: hmm deploy-bot shows a canary -> full roll 6m ago. maybe model A increased tokenization cost for long prompts.

mateo: mitigation options: 1) roll back to previous model, 2) temporarily reduce max_batch_size, 3) route small requests to model-b fallback pool. I can roll back if we decide.

sophia: priority is customer-facing latency. rollback to v1.4.2 now, please. I'll announce to customers if rollback clears.

mateo: starting rollback now. cmd:
```
kubectl -n prod set image deployment/runtime-proxy runtime-proxy=registry.redwood/model-a:v1.4.2 && kubectl rollout status deployment/runtime-proxy -w
```

incident-bot: PagerDuty -> pd-889302 status: acknowledged by sophia

zack: k, sending traffic to fallback pool for /v1/embeddings and /v1/small-gen to reduce pressure

ana: metrics noise settling — p99 dropping from 1.82s -> 1.1s in last 90s

mateo: rollout reported success, runtime-proxy back to v1.4.2 on all pods.

sophia: nice. I'm posting a short customer note to status page: "We detected elevated inference latency in EU; mitigated by rolling back model canary. No data loss, partial impact for ~10m."

zack: one follow-up: collect a sample of prompts that caused long tails (I pulled 120 KV miss traces) and attach to the postmortem.

mateo: handing off monitoring to next on-call @sophia -> @mateo (30m watch). I'm going offline for a quick break but reachable.

sophia: ack, taking over monitoring. will keep PD open until stable for 30m.

incident-bot: PagerDuty -> RESOLVED pd-889302 (resolution: rollback to v1.4.2, traffic rebalanced)

mateo: filing short incident note in #postmortems with timeline + TODOs (investigate why autoscaler queued scale-up and why kvcache eviction spiked).

sophia: thanks team :thumbsup: we should add a canary slow-start flag to future rollouts to avoid full canary flip.

zack: noted. adding to the ops runbook: "model-rollout: validate tokenization cost and warm kv-cache gradually"

ana: good catch. I'll start the data collection for regression tests.

sophia: closing thread, will link postmortem when ready."
